item.checks: Damaged returns tagged yellow and put in inspection, not shelved even if unopened; no immediate return to customer or employee locker. Talk, cue and key evidence all exact. Numbered stem heard by ASR as “damaged return products” in contiguous cue bank and isolated actual stem at 1.00× / 0.90× / 1.12×; displayed stem says “damaged returned products.” Meaning and answer unaffected, but final -ed needs independent lexical corroboration; not a demonstrated recording error.

transcript: Welcome to your first shift at Westfield Distribution.
Before we go on to the warehouse floor, please put your personal belongings in the lockers behind you.
Your locker number is printed on the back of your identification card.
Today you'll work with an experienced colleague rather than operate equipment alone.
The first task is checking returned goods against the accompanying forms.
Do not send damaged products directly back to the shelves, even when the customer has marked the package as unopened.
Put them in the inspection area with a yellow tag.
At 11, we'll meet in the training room for a demonstration of the inventory scanners.
If you finish the returns early, ask your colleague to show you the emergency exits.
